phases.description: HOLLIS holds ELI's look, quite still

questions.question: 0-0.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS looks at ELI?
0.5-4.7s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS speaks to ELI sharply?
4.7-6s HOLD: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS holds ELI's look, quite still?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): HOLLIS speaks to ELI
HOLLIS: does the face/body read as forceful, wary (restrained)? Must NOT read as: calm.
Line 666 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: HOLLIS: Moreno, get your notebook out. We're writing this up right now.
HOLLIS sounds like the voice bible: low, gravelly male voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC06_g01: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket; the notebook: in ELI's chest pocket.

Last frame matches state SC06_g02: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket; the notebook: in ELI's chest pocket.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Corners (all four, full size): any watermark, logo, sparkle or text? Name it and its corner. The known Gemini sparkle bottom-right is recorded, not removed (Owner decision); any other mark fails.
Line 666: does HOLLIS clearly speak to ELI (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where ELI stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do HOLLIS's eyes go to frame-right, well clear of the lens?
Does HOLLIS look at ELI and never into the lens?
Do ELI and HOLLIS stay on their own sides (frosted-glass hallway door / counter, staff side and archive shelves) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look. Questions with an id (REL_*) need a short answer in the group check's answers{id: text}; without it the take cannot be ACCEPTED.
